svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Buy 110 links of 6 mm grade 80 chain (about 1.98 m) with its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: certificate, cut to length by the supplier. Count the links.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Never weld, heat, grind or bend the chain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One end (the adjustable end): fit the master link with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm grade 80 connecting link and peen its pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Other end (the fixed end): it goes into the front slot; a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: second connecting link ties its 6th link through the tether hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the 56th, 72nd and 100th links from the fixed end: the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: link that drops into the rear slot on 200, 300 and 450 trunks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn: eight links, the connecting link and the master link.
